change: Extend the direct report SQL inventory to compare named binds with literal parameter mappings and simple branch-correlated list/map mutations.
regressions: SQLAlchemy :name and psycopg %(name)s named placeholders match literal mapping keys.
Each Data Stream optional date filter's SQL append is paired with the mapping update in the same branch.
Mismatched mapping keys are reported, while nested and unrecognized list/map mutations remain unresolved.

Helper-query named binds and populated report output parity are not established.
